Lena: Quick ping 1do we have carryover this year? A few on my squad are stockpiling days for a Jan launch.
Maya (People Ops): Short version: yes, but 2025 is a one-time changewe're permitting up to 56 hours (7 days) carryover into 2026 to help teams recover from the ramp. Standard policy outside this window is 40h. Anything above 56h needs manager + People Ops + Finance approval.
Diego: Does that include sick or bereavement?
Maya (People Ops): No. Sick, bereavement, and comp-time are separate. Sick accruals follow local law and may carry per-country rules. If someone is outside the US, please DM me so we can confirm local entitlements.
Lena: What's the accrual schedule now? My new hire asked today.
Sam (Payroll): Current accruals (US full-time): `0-6 months: 60h/year (~2.31h/pay)`, `6-24 months: 120h/year (~4.62h/pay)`, `24+ months: 160h/year (~6.15h/pay)`. Accruals post every payroll; part-timers are prorated by FTE. Full matrix is in HRIS > Policies.
Diego: How do people submit a carryover? Deadlines?
Maya (People Ops): Submit a "Carryover Request" in the Time Off section of HRIS by Jan 12, 2026. Managers must approve there; People Ops performs the final review for exceptions. We take a snapshot of balances at 2025-12-31 23:59 UTC. Approved carryover posts on Jan 15; any excess above the allowed cap will be reduced automatically on Jan 18 unless an exception was approved.
Lena: What about managers who will be OOO during approvals?
Maya (People Ops): Managers should set an approval delegate in HRIS before Dec 20. If no delegate exists, People Ops will triage urgent approvals, but please don't rely on that workflow.
Diego: Contractors? Temps?
Maya (People Ops): Contractors and agency temps do not accrue company PTO by default. Managers can request discretionary paid time off for contractors via People Ops; approvals are case-by-case and charged to the hiring team's budget.
Lena: Emergency advanced PTO options? Someone might need days before accruals catch up.
Maya (People Ops): Managers can approve advanced PTO (negative balance) up to 40 hours for emergencies; People Ops + Payroll signoff required for anything beyond that. Advanced balances must be reconciled within the next two quarters either by accruals or unpaid deduction. For extended LOAs we route through Leave of Absence and require documentation.
Sam (Payroll): Note: any unpaid deductions or payroll adjustments due to advances will be reflected on the next available payroll after reconciliation.
Diego: Any blackout windows we should plan around for the Jan launch?
Maya (People Ops): Soft blackout for product/infra core: Nov 30  Dec 6, 2025 (customer launch prep). Company-wide end-of-year reduced coverage: Dec 24  Dec 31, 2025 (staggered rotations allowed with manager approval). If you need planned coverage, mark delegates in HRIS now.
Timekeeper Bot: Reminder: PTO snapshot scheduled for 2025-12-31 23:59 UTC. Verify time-off entries and carryover requests before Jan 12.
Lena: Awesome, I'll tell the team to submit by Jan 12 and set delegates. Thanks!
